answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond, decaying 5% per epoch and expiring in 20 epochs without verified renewal, like yarrow without water. Auditors check renewals, so clones cannot persist. A vine of fakes sharing one proof is flagged and their bonds burn. Making 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus renewal work, while one honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards; no velvet cover hides expiry.
